f","on_background":"#093457","surface_container":"#e4efff","primary_dim":"#0745c8","background":"#f8f9ff","tertiary_fixed_dim":"#dacff0","surface_container_highest":"#d1e4ff","surface_variant":"#d1e4ff","on_tertiary":"#fdf7ff","surface_dim":"#c2dcff"},"designMd":"# Repair Atlas — Precision Workbench

## Project
Stitch project 12538434318285344375. Desktop web interface for reviewing automated repairs, verification evidence, and delivery decisions. Chinese interface with English code identifiers.

## Visual Theme & Atmosphere
An exacting developer tool with the clarity of an issue tracker and the evidence focus of an observability workspace. Calm, compact, professional, and editorially precise. Clear contrast between global navigation, working canvas and evidence panels. No marketing hero, illustrations, fake charts, decorative gradients or oversized KPI cards.

## Color Palette & Roles
- Canvas: cool off-white #F6F7F9.
- Main workspace: white #FFFFFF.
- Global navigation: deep graphite #171B22; active item #283346.
- Primary ink: #20252E; muted text #687382; separators #E5E9EF.
- Interaction accent: precise blue #3662E3, reserved for selections, links and primary actions.
- Success #198263; waiting #B17A20; failure #C45050. Every status also has an explicit text label.
- Diff additions and removals use low-contrast tinted backgrounds, readable text, aligned line numbers.

## Typography Rules
IBM Plex Sans for Latin text with Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei for Chinese. IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono for identifiers, paths and code. Page title 24–28px, panel title 14px, body 13–14px, metadata 11–12px. Tabular numerals. No all-capital decorative overlines on each card.

## Component Stylings
216px global sidebar, 52px breadcrumb bar. Controls 32–36px high, 6px corners; panels 8px corners, one-pixel separators. Dense tables with 60–72px rows, generous main-column width and low-priority facts collapsed. Use single-line status labels with small dots. Main task workspace has a narrow task queue, readable evidence body and contextual inspector. A task's final result and next action should be visible without scrolling.

## Layout Principles
At 1440px, let the main workspace use available width; no giant empty margins. Choose intentional density over stacked generic cards. A horizontal stage strip is navigable, not a diagram of backend internals. On detail screens use progressive disclosure via tabs. Show task names, business verdicts and next actions before raw node names and JSON. Approval controls sit in a clearly attached bottom action bar.

## State Semantics
Execution success, business validation, approval state and published delivery are independent. A local candidate is labeled 本地候选 / 待审批; it must not be labeled 已交付. Parent batches may continue while a task waits for approval. Unknown, blocked and stale evidence have explicit labels. No invented production metrics: all sample content is visibly a design sample.
